name: limit-watch
description: Shows the subscription usage limits, the per-model weekly ones such as Fable's included, under the prompt or in the shared sidebar with a reset countdown and a projection, opens a /limit-watch pane, gives the model a tool that reads them, logs once when a limit passes 80% and 95%, tells the model when one passes 80%, 90% and 95%, and stops sampling entirely with /limit-watch off.
